gloss: early human; archaic human (Homo erectus stage)

definitions.gloss: early human; archaic human (Homo erectus stage)
definitions.explanation: In the study of human evolution, an early human of the Homo erectus stage, more advanced than the ape-like {猿人|えんじん} but earlier than {旧人|きゅうじん} and modern humans. Often appears in the names of specific finds, such as {北京原人|ぺきんげんじん} (Peking Man).

examples.japanese: {原人|げんじん}は{火|ひ}を{使|つか}っていた。
{北京原人|ぺきんげんじん}の{化石|かせき}が{発見|はっけん}された。
examples.english: Fossils of Peking Man were discovered.

examples.japanese: {原人|げんじん}は{猿人|えんじん}より{進化|しんか}した{段階|だんかい}に{位置|いち}づけられる。
examples.english: Archaic humans are placed at a more evolved stage than the ape-men.

notes:
Compound of {原|げん} (original, primitive) + {人|じん} (person). A term from paleoanthropology denoting one stage in human evolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北京原人|ぺきんげんじん}: Peking Man
- {ジャワ原人|ジャワげんじん}: Java Man
- {原人|げんじん}の{化石|かせき}: fossils of early humans

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猿人|えんじん}: ape-man — an earlier, more primitive stage
- {旧人|きゅうじん}: archaic Homo (e.g. Neanderthals) — a later stage
- {新人|しんじん}: anatomically modern humans (in this paleoanthropology sense)
